title: Diabetes emergencies in the hospital: DKA, HHS and hypoglycemia
question: From this hospital discharge summary, assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's diabetes (only that code).
note:
Admission Date: 05/12/2026
Discharge Date: 05/15/2026
Reason for Admission: Unresponsive and hypoglycemi coma.

Hospital Course:
Pt is an 83 y.o. female with hx of T2DM. Found unresponsive at home; arrived via EMS in a hypoglycemi coma. Initial labs confirmed severe hypoglycemia. Managed with IV dextrose bolus and continuous infusion. Pt stabilized and regained consciousness within 2 hours. Remained stable for observation. No acute neurological deficits noted. Transitioned to oral intake. Pt stable for discharge.

Discharge Diagnoses:
1. Hypoglycemi coma
2. T2DM

Discharge Medications:
1. Metformin 500mg BID
2. Glipizide 5mg daily
3. Multivitamin daily

Follow-up:
Pt to f/u with PCP in 1 week for glucose monitoring and medication reconciliation.

Electronically signed
P. O'Brien, MD
05/15/2026
explanations: Type 2 diabetes with hypoglycemia with coma: E11.641 (HCC 36).
